_comment: Questions for TypeSafe Jev (jef). `question` -> instructions, `options` -> criteria (scripts/jef_run.py). Option descriptions are what the model compares against: keep them concrete. See docs/jef-task.md.

questions.question: What is the main policy area of the Israeli bill whose Hebrew title is in `bill_title_hebrew`?

options.judiciary: Courts, judges, judicial selection, Supreme Court powers, attorney general and legal advisers, legal aid, Basic Law: The Judiciary (בתי משפט, שופטים, היועץ המשפטי, חוק-יסוד: השפיטה)
options.governance: Government and Knesset structure, elections, term limits, ministers, coalition rules, civil service, local authorities' powers, state comptroller, transparency and anti-corruption of officials (הממשלה, הכנסת, בחירות, רשויות מקומיות, מבקר המדינה)
options.religion_state: Religion and state: rabbinate, rabbis, religious courts, kashrut, Shabbat and rest days, conversion, holy places, religious services (רבנות, דיינים, כשרות, שבת, גיור, שירותי דת)
options.military_service: Military and national service: conscription, Haredi draft exemptions, reservists' and soldiers' rights and benefits, lone soldiers, disabled veterans, national-civil service (שירות ביטחון, גיוס, מילואים, חיילים, שירות לאומי)
options.security_terror: Defense and counter-terrorism: security offenses, terrorists and their families, emergency regulations for security detainees, aiding the enemy, death penalty for terrorists (טרור, מחבלים, עבירות ביטחון, אויב)
options.territories_foreign: Judea and Samaria (West Bank), sovereignty and annexation, settlements, Jerusalem status, Palestinian Authority, UNRWA, foreign relations (יהודה והשומרון, ריבונות, ירושלים, הרשות הפלסטינית, אונר"א)
options.arab_society: Arab citizens and minorities: Bedouin, Druze, absentee property, nation-state law, Arabic language status (החברה הערבית, בדואים, דרוזים, נכסי נפקדים, חוק הלאום)
options.war_victims_home_front: Victims of war and terror and the home front: October 7 / Iron Swords war, hostages and released captives, evacuees, bereaved families, compensation for victims of hostile acts, shelters (חטופים, מפונים, חרבות ברזל, נפגעי פעולות איבה, משפחות שכולות, מיגון)
options.economy_fiscal: State budget, taxes, VAT, income tax, economic arrangements laws, banking and finance regulation, companies, pensions and capital markets (תקציב, מסים, מע"מ, מס הכנסה, ההתייעלות הכלכלית, חברות)
options.cost_of_living_consumer: Cost of living and consumer protection: prices, competition, monopolies, standards and imports, bank fees, bounced checks, consumer safety (יוקר המחיה, הגנת הצרכן, תקנים, שיקים, עמלות)
options.housing_planning: Housing, real estate, planning and building, public housing, construction (דיור, תכנון ובנייה, מקרקעין, דיור ציבורי)
options.labor_welfare: Labor law and social welfare: employment rights, women's work, parental leave, national insurance benefits, unemployment, elderly allowances, income support, poverty (עבודה, ביטוח לאומי, דמי אבטלה, הבטחת הכנסה, קצבאות)
options.health: Health system: health insurance, hospitals, medical professions, patients' rights, medicines, MDA, mental health, smoking, fertility (בריאות, קופות חולים, בתי חולים, רופאים, זכויות החולה)
options.education: Education: schools, compulsory education, curriculum, teachers, higher education, students' rights (חינוך, לימוד חובה, השכלה גבוהה, סטודנטים)
options.criminal_justice: Criminal law and policing: penal code, police, prisons, organized crime, weapons, sexual offenses, domestic violence, criminal procedure, victims of crime (עונשין, משטרה, בתי סוהר, ארגוני פשיעה, אלימות במשפחה)
options.civil_rights_equality: Civil rights and equality: anti-discrimination, gender equality, LGBT, disability rights and accessibility, freedom of speech, Basic Law: Human Dignity and Liberty (שוויון, הפליה, אנשים עם מוגבלות, נגישות, כבוד האדם וחירותו)
options.media_tech: Media, broadcasting, press, telecom, internet, online privacy and data protection (תקשורת, שידור, עיתונות, אינטרנט, הגנת פרטיות)
options.transport_infrastructure: Transport, roads, traffic, public transport, aviation, energy, water and infrastructure (תחבורה, תעבורה, כבישים, אנרגיה, מים)
options.environment_animals: Environment and climate, pollution, recycling, plastic, nature, animal welfare, fishing (סביבה, אקלים, זיהום, מחזור, בעלי חיים)
options.immigration_absorption: Aliyah and absorption of immigrants, citizenship, migrants and asylum seekers (עלייה, קליטה, אזרחות, מסתננים)
options.culture_heritage: Culture, heritage, commemoration and memorial days, national symbols and decorations, Hebrew language, sport (הנצחה, יום זיכרון, מורשת, תרבות, ספורט)
options.other: Other or purely technical: civil law, intellectual property, procedural or technical amendments with no clear policy area

questions.question: Does the Israeli bill in `bill_title_hebrew` deal with a value-laden, ideologically contested issue (identity, religion, security, territory, judiciary, minority or civil rights) rather than a technical, administrative or purely economic matter?
